tools.name: read_page
tools.description: Get an accessibility-tree representation of the page with stable element reference IDs (e.g. ref_1) usable by other tools. Returns all elements by default. If output exceeds max_chars, narrow with ref_id or reduce depth.

ref_id.description: Focus on this element and its descendants only.

tools.name: find
tools.description: Locate elements by natural-language description (e.g. 'search bar', 'add to cart button'). Returns up to 20 matches with reference IDs. Use a more specific query if too many results.

query.description: Natural-language description of the target element.

tools.name: get_page_text
tools.description: Extract readable text content from a page, prioritizing article body. Use for long-form reading instead of read_page when full DOM is unnecessary.

tools.name: computer
tools.description: Mouse, keyboard, and screenshot interactions. Prefer 'ref' over 'coordinate' when targeting elements; coordinates survive poorly across scrolls and layout changes. Some fields are required only for specific actions (see field descriptions).

coordinate.description: [x, y] in viewport pixels. Required for click/hover/scroll/drag end position when no 'ref'.

ref.description: Element reference from read_page/find. Alternative to coordinate for click/hover. Required for scroll_to.

text.description: Required for 'type' (text to type) and 'key' (e.g. 'Enter', 'cmd+a', space-separated for sequences).

region.description: [x0, y0, x1, y1] rectangle. Required for 'zoom'.

tools.name: form_input
tools.description: Set the value of a form element by reference. Use string for text inputs, boolean for checkboxes, value or visible text for selects.

value.description: Value to set. Type depends on input kind.

tools.name: navigate
tools.description: Navigate a tab to a URL, or move through history with 'back'/'forward'. Protocol defaults to https:// if omitted.

force.description: If true, discard unsaved changes when a 'Leave site?' dialog appears.

tools.name: tabs_context
tools.description: List all tabs in the current group with their tabId, title, and URL. Call when no valid tabId is known.

tools.name: tabs_create
tools.description: Create a new empty tab in the current group and return its tabId.

tools.name: browser_batch
tools.description: Execute a sequence of tool calls in one round trip. Runs sequentially, stops on first error. Use for predictable multi-step flows (click → type → key). Cannot be nested.

input.description: Exact input object for that tool.

tools.name: file_upload
tools.description: Upload local files to a <input type='file'> element by reference. Do NOT click file inputs — that opens a native picker the agent cannot see.

ref.description: Reference of the file input element.

tools.name: upload_image
tools.description: Upload a previously-captured screenshot or user-provided image to a file input (via ref) or drop target (via coordinate). Provide ref OR coordinate, not both.

imageId.description: ID of a prior screenshot or uploaded image.

ref.description: Target element reference (use for hidden file inputs).

coordinate.description: [x, y] drop target for visible drag-and-drop zones.

tools.name: read_console_messages
tools.description: Read browser console messages (log/warn/error) from a tab. Always pass a 'pattern' to filter — unfiltered output is usually overwhelming.

clear.description: Clear after reading to avoid duplicates next call.

tools.name: read_network_requests
tools.description: Read HTTP requests (XHR, fetch, documents, etc.) from a tab. Auto-cleared on cross-domain navigation. Filter with urlPattern to keep output manageable.

tools.name: javascript_tool
tools.description: Evaluate JavaScript in the page context. Returns the value of the last expression — do NOT use 'return' at top level. Use sparingly; prefer DOM tools when possible.

text.description: JavaScript source. Last expression is returned.

tools.name: resize_window
tools.description: Resize the browser window containing a tab. Useful for responsive testing.

tools.name: tabs
tools.description: Manage browser tabs. Actions: 'list' (returns all tabs with IDs/titles/URLs — call when you don't have a tabId), 'create' (opens a new empty tab and returns its ID), 'close' (closes a tab by ID), 'switch' (brings a tab to the foreground so the user sees it), 'reload' (refreshes a tab). tabId is required for close/switch/reload.

tabId.description: Target tab. Required for close, switch, reload.

tools.name: update_plan
tools.description: Write or revise the plan for the current task and surface it to the user before executing. Use at the start of any non-trivial multi-step task, and again whenever the plan materially changes. Listed domains become approved for the session when the user accepts.

domains.description: Domains the plan will visit, e.g. ['github.com', 'stackoverflow.com'].

tools.name: ask_user
tools.description: Pause and ask the user a question when input is needed to proceed (ambiguity, missing info, required confirmation). Use 'confirm' for yes/no, 'choice' for a fixed set of options, 'text' for free-form input. Prefer this over guessing on destructive or sensitive actions.

question.description: The question to show the user.

context.description: Optional one-line context for why you're asking.

tools.name: notify_user
tools.description: Send a one-way status update to the user without pausing for a response. Use sparingly for milestones in long tasks. Do NOT use to ask questions — use ask_user for that.

tools.name: find_text_on_page
tools.description: Literal Ctrl+F-style text search within a tab. Returns matches with surrounding context and refs to the containing elements. Use this instead of get_page_text when you only need to know if/where specific text appears.

regex.description: Treat query as a regex. Default false.

tools.name: wait_for
tools.description: Poll until a condition is met or timeout. Use after navigation or actions that trigger async loads — far more reliable than fixed sleeps. Conditions: 'element' (ref or selector exists and is visible), 'text' (text appears anywhere on page), 'url' (tab URL matches substring or regex), 'network_idle' (no in-flight requests for ~500ms).

target.description: Element ref/selector, text string, or URL pattern. Required for element/text/url.

tools.name: downloads
tools.description: Manage file downloads triggered by the page or agent. Actions: 'list' (returns pending/completed downloads with IDs, filenames, sizes, sources), 'confirm' (approves a pending download by ID — required before any file is written), 'cancel' (aborts a pending download). Downloads must be confirmed by the user; the agent should surface them via ask_user before calling 'confirm'.

tools.name: get_element_details
tools.description: Deep inspection of a single element by ref: full attribute set, computed styles, bounding box, visibility, and innerHTML. Use when read_page's summary isn't enough — e.g. reading data-* attributes or checking if something is hidden by CSS. Avoids needing javascript_tool for routine introspection.

include_html.description: Include innerHTML. Default false (can be large).

tools.name: memory
tools.description: Session-scoped scratchpad for stashing structured notes across turns without burning context tokens. Actions: 'set' (write a value to a key), 'get' (read by key), 'list' (all keys), 'delete' (remove a key). Values are stringified; keep them small. Cleared at session end.

value.description: Required for set. Stringify objects before passing.

tools.name: read_pdf
tools.description: Extract text and structure from a PDF loaded in a browser tab. Use when the tab URL ends in .pdf or read_page returns no useful content. Returns text by page with optional page range.

tools.name: gif_creator
tools.description: Record browser actions and export as an animated GIF. Actions: 'start_recording', 'stop_recording', 'export' (generates and either downloads or drops onto a page element), 'clear' (discard frames). Take a screenshot right after start and right before stop to capture clean first/last frames.

tabId.description: Tab whose group this applies to.

download.description: Download instead of drag-drop. For 'export' only.

coordinate.description: [x, y] drop target. For 'export' when download is false.

options.description: Optional GIF rendering toggles. For 'export' only.
